modelConfig.geoTreeSelection: At most 4000 trees with 100-round early stopping on each inner validation period, as in the trainer.
modelConfig.featureSelection: Choose geography only when inner median-price MAPE is strictly lower; the old notebook model is a diagnostic baseline, not a shipping candidate.
modelConfig.calibration: Trainer recency_calibration on chosen candidate inner-validation quantile residuals only; retain these dollar offsets after refitting on full outer training history.
modelConfig.preprocessing: Inner categories, geo-coverage gate and town centroids use inner training only; refit preprocessing uses full outer training only. Trend is capped at each fit cutoff, while age and lease use sale month.
modelConfig.search: Original candidate settings only; no hyperparameter grid and no deployed tree counts reused for the geographic candidate.

definitions.servedCoverage: Fraction of actual prices inside the inclusive serving predictionBand after dollar calibration, rounding and minimum widening.
definitions.rawCoverage: Fraction inside serving rawBand: ordered quantiles plus inner-only dollar calibration, before rounding and minimum widening.
definitions.medianWidthPercent: Median of each full served band width divided by its rounded estimate, times 100.
definitions.meanWidthPercent: Mean of each full served band width divided by its rounded estimate, times 100.
definitions.mapePercent: Mean absolute percentage error of the rounded serving median estimate.
definitions.falseHoldRate: Fraction of actual sale prices flagged by serving flagReason when treated as asking prices: above high or strictly below 70% of low; a proxy, not observed moderation errors.
definitions.pooled: Concatenate disjoint outer-test sales once; compute row-weighted metrics, including the median width from all rows, rather than averaging fold summaries.
definitions.weakestSubgroups: Five lowest served-coverage town or flat-type marginal groups with at least 30 outer sales, pooled or within each fold; full subgroup metrics are also retained.

limitations: Historical nested evaluation of the existing candidate family, not a fresh prospective holdout or a guarantee of future coverage.
The original no-geography candidate retains its trainer's fixed tree counts; the existing candidate family and structural hyperparameters were developed previously, not selected anew here.
Inner validation is reused for feature/tree selection and calibration; outer tests provide evaluation only, and earlier outer sales become history in later rolling folds.
Local static block and MRT files are used, not historical geography snapshots.
The deployed model was refit on all data through October 2026; this script evaluates temporary historical refits and never replaces the artifact.
